newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Umax Jan-Dec net at T$646.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Umax Jan-Dec net at T$646.9 mln.

text.p: Taiwan manufacturer Umax Data Systems Inc reported on Thursday a 97.55 percent growth in net profit in 1996 to T$646.9 million from 1995's T$327 million.

The company, which was only listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in January 1996, registered all-year sales at T$6.3 billion, 72.64 percent more than 1995's T$3.65 billion, a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
Rising sales of its scanners and computers had enabled the sharp business growth of the firm, she said.

In January 1997 alone, the company's sales revenue soared 198 percent to T$987 million from T$331 million in January 1996, according to a company's statement, adding net profit in January 1997 stood at T$126 million.
Umax has set a 1997 pre-tax profit of T$1.46 billion on sales of T$15.344 billion.
Umax and its U.S. unit Umax Computer Corp are among several Asian manufacturers licenced to design and make Mac-compatible clones that run on Apple Computer's Mac OS operating system.
